title: 下载 Talia
description: 协调 AI 智能体，使用你的文档，将重复任务转化为有序的工作。
hero: 你的团队。不只是又一个聊天机器人。
intro: 协调 AI 智能体，使用你的文档，将重复任务转化为有序的工作。
availability: macOS、Windows 和 Linux · 以各版本为准。预览软件。
shotCaption: 添加真实截图，而非模拟界面。使用不含个人数据的演示内容。
shot1: 你的下一个项目，就在这里。
shot1body: 展示包含 Commander、团队和文档的项目。
b1body: 在项目中收集来源。索引就绪后，检索相关片段，并要求回答提供文档引用。
benefit2: 工作不再淹没在聊天中。
b2body: 在看板中跟踪任务、分配和进度，区分待办、进行中和待核查的工作。
b3body: 邀请研究、写作和开发专家，选择与工作和授权兼容的模型、技能和连接器。
capabilities: 功能取决于模型、已安装资源、已配置服务和权限。外部服务可能需要单独的账户和费用。
story2: 从你的来源开始，而不是空白。
shot2body: 展示项目文档及带有来源引用的回答。
shot3body: 展示演示项目的看板：每日任务、分配和可打开的简报。
warning: 当前 macOS 安装包使用临时签名，未经公证；需手动安装。Windows 和 Linux 安装包无 Authenticode 或 AppImage 签名，可能出现安全警告。仅下方标注的安装包支持自动更新。
integrity: SHA-256 验证文件完整性，不验证作者身份或软件安全性。
portable: 解压 ZIP 并运行 Talia.exe
empty: 暂无已验证版本。请稍后重试或访问 GitHub。
error: 无法读取版本索引。请在 GitHub 查看文件。
sessionOnly: 语言仅在本次会话生效：浏览器存储不可用。
cycle1: 安排 — 自动化每天早上请求创建项目简报任务。
cycle2: 组织 — 请求在看板中创建每日任务，并列明预期成果和参考来源。
cycle3: 推进 — 启用待办执行后，可用智能体处理已授权的任务。
cycle4: 检查 — 打开简报，核查引用并处理审批请求。
cycleNote: 这是可配置流程示例，不是实时演示。定时调度与待办执行相互独立：创建任务不会自动启动任务。需要应用可用、文档已索引、资源和权限就绪；阻塞和审批需要你处理。
demoMicrocopy: Interactive demo · sample data · no real execution
demoBadge: Demo · sample data · no real execution
replicaTitle: Step inside — it looks like the real app
replicaIntro: Real clicks, real tabs, fake results. Look around or follow the tour.
tour1Body: Ask the team. Agents pick up the task and divide the work.
tour2Body: Agents look up your documents and cite what they find.
tour3Body: A first draft arrives, with clickable source references.
tour4Body: Ask for changes. Sensitive actions wait for your approval.
tour5Body: Work is tracked as tasks and saved in your environment.
teamText: Agents with different roles, skills and connectors from a store — and, if you like, your own already-installed CLI tools (Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode…) as new team members.
cliNote: Requires the CLI already installed and authenticated on your computer.
taskBody: Who does what, and where it stands.
projectBody: Chats, tasks and documents in one shared team space.
searchBody: One keystroke to find everything: tasks, Library, agents, skills, automations.
ragNote: Responses can cite the documents you upload to the Library. (demo: synthetic citations, no live retrieval)
trustTitle: You decide how much latitude to grant
trustText: From confirmation on every sensitive action to full autonomy: three levels, not all-or-nothing.
permStandardBody: Balance autonomy with confirmation on key steps.
counterLabel: A counter shows what you are consuming, always visible in the sidebar.
crossText: Different providers in the same team, and connectors toward the services you already use.
closeTitle: The apps you build stay with you
closeText: Calculators, trackers, small dashboards: you build them, use them and save them in your Talia environment.
searchHint: Press Esc to close · simulated results
dMsg1: Prepare the weekly briefing using the project documents.
dMsg2: Assigning the briefing to Research Writer and looking up sources in the Library.
dMsg3: Draft ready. I cited 3 sources from the Library.
dMsg4: Tighten the intro and summarize the sources.
dMsg5: Done. I created the task “Weekly briefing” on the Kanban board.
dApproval: Connecting to the service requires your approval.
dSrc1: “Talia coordinates agents around shared documents and tasks.”
dSrc2: “The weekly briefing summarizes progress and next steps.”
dSrc3: “Users asked for sources they can trace back to their files.”
sClaudeDesc: Your local CLI as an agent.
sCodexDesc: Your local CLI as an agent.
providerNote: Provider and service names shown for illustration only.
dragHint: Drag cards between columns (visual only — resets when you switch tabs).
composerPlaceholder: Type @ to choose agents, skills, connectors, Library files.
agentsHint: The team working on this conversation.
autoTitle: Plan it once, follow it every day
accessBody: Connect providers by signing into an existing account or by bringing your own API key — not just pay-per-use.
accessOauthBody: Sign into an existing account (e.g. Claude Pro / ChatGPT).
accessApiBody: Paste the key you created in the provider's console.
accessCliBody: Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode… use the account and settings already configured in that tool.
accessNote: Not universal or unlimited: each provider's own terms and fees apply.
accessHeadline: Not just API. Your subscriptions work too.
feat1Body: Specialist agents pick up the work, divide it, and hand it off — with citations from your documents and clear approval gates for sensitive steps.
feat1Bullet1: One task, several specialists in parallel.
feat1Bullet2: Each reply cites the documents it used.
feat1Bullet3: Sensitive actions wait for your approval.
workBody: Tasks, projects, documents and automations share one space. A single keystroke finds any of them.
sourcesBody: When an agent cites a document, you can open the source, see the passage and decide whether to trust it.
storeBody: Agents, skills, connectors and external CLIs. Each one optional, all of them local.
downloadSub: macOS, Windows and Linux · preview software.
